The '''Aesolian system''' was a [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aesolian]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Species/Legends|creatures]] known as [[treton]]s.<ref name="DangerousGames" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Aesolian system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it within grid square I-15.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
